name: Kono Subarashiki Ryoujoku EDEN
source:
Rin's life with her friend at Sakakibara Academy was the same every day.
Then one day Rin became stalked.
With her parents unreachable on overseas holiday, Rin was all too aware of her defenselessness. In a panic, she fled for her life.

But, the men who stalked her were prepared for this---

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE174750.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
凛与朋友在Sakakibara学园的生活日复一日，平淡如常。
直到有一天，凛遭到了跟踪。
父母正在海外度假，无法联系，凛清楚地意识到自己毫无自保能力。惊慌之下，她拼命逃走。

然而，跟踪她的那些男人早已为此做好准备——
